title: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend milling or planing machines to mill, plane, shape, groove, or profile metal or plastic work pieces.

projection.title: Milling and planing machine setters, operators, and tenders, metal and plastic

tasks.text: Remove workpieces from machines, and check to ensure that they conform to specifications, using measuring instruments such as microscopes, gauges, calipers, and micrometers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Verify alignment of workpieces on machines, using measuring instruments such as rules, gauges, or calipers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Move controls to set cutting specifications, to position cutting tools and workpieces in relation to each other, and to start machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Observe milling or planing machine operation, and adjust controls to ensure conformance with specified tolerances.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.text: Select and install cutting tools and other accessories according to specifications, using hand tools or power tools.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Position and secure workpieces on machines, using holding devices, measuring instruments, hand tools, and hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Replace worn tools, using hand tools, and sharpen dull tools, using bench grinders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.
Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Study blueprints, layouts, sketches, or work orders to assess workpiece specifications and to determine tooling instructions, tools and materials needed, and sequences of operations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Compute dimensions, tolerances, and angles of workpieces or machines according to specifications and knowledge of metal properties and shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Move cutters or material manually or by turning handwheels, or engage automatic feeding mechanisms to mill workpieces to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Mount attachments and tools, such as pantographs, engravers, or routers, to perform other operations, such as drilling or boring.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Select cutting speeds, feed rates, and depths of cuts, applying knowledge of metal properties and shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment settings need machine-specific judgment

dwas.name: Determine production equipment settings.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Turn valves or pull levers to start and regulate the flow of coolant or lubricant to work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical construction of templates and work aids

dwas.name: Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.
